requirements.title: Passive discovery must not execute discovered commands
requirements.statement: A passive discovery or scan operation MUST NOT launch commands, tools, hooks, MCP servers, or other executable content discovered in project configuration.

requirements.title: Evidence chains preserve sequence and predecessor binding
requirements.statement: Evidence verification MUST reject duplicate, missing, reordered, or predecessor-inconsistent events when the chain claims ordered integrity.

requirements.title: Approvals are one-time and scope-bound
requirements.statement: An approval grant MUST be bound to the exact normalized request and policy decision scope and MUST NOT authorize a second dispatch after consumption.

requirements.title: Evidence strength must never be silently upgraded
requirements.statement: An implementation MUST NOT report L2 isolation from L1 brokering, or L3 attestation from local observation, unless a concrete boundary or configured trust root proves the stronger claim.

requirements.title: Policy decisions bind request and policy digests
requirements.statement: A policy decision used for dispatch MUST bind the normalized request and the exact policy bundle evaluated; a digest mismatch MUST fail closed.

requirements.title: Unknown provenance is not verified provenance
requirements.statement: An implementation MUST NOT promote declared, inferred, floating, or unavailable provenance to verified provenance without supporting resolution evidence.

requirements.title: Claimed tests are not observed tests
requirements.statement: An implementation MUST NOT report a test as observed solely because a command, log line, or agent statement claims that the test ran.

requirements.title: Bundle verification is bounded and traversal-safe
requirements.statement: Evidence bundle verification MUST reject unsafe paths and MUST enforce configured size and expansion limits before materializing untrusted archive content.

requirements.title: Capability expansion remains distinguishable from reduction
requirements.statement: Trust-diff processing MUST preserve the direction of capability changes and MUST identify added authority without treating a reduction as equivalent risk.

requirements.title: MCP schema drift is checked before tool dispatch
requirements.statement: When an MCP tool definition changes from the accepted baseline, the broker MUST evaluate the current definition before dispatch and MUST fail closed when the change invalidates the authorization basis.

requirements.title: Broad shell grants are not equivalent to precise capabilities
requirements.statement: An implementation MUST NOT treat an unrestricted shell or opaque nested interpreter grant as equivalent to a narrowly classified direct-argv capability.

requirements.title: Secret egress decisions bind sensitive source and destination
requirements.statement: A secret-egress control MUST evaluate the sensitive source and outbound destination before allowing dispatch and must preserve non-secret evidence sufficient to explain the decision.
